title: Quebec election: Voters head to the polls to choose next provincial government

blocks.text: Everything you need to know to vote in Quebec’s 2026 election
After weeks of campaigning, election day and early voting are around the corner. Here’s what you need to know to cast your ballot.

items: Voters in Quebec are choosing their next provincial government today after a crowded campaign dominated by the economy and talk of a potential referendum.
One of the main five parties would need at least 64 seats to form a majority government, with 127 members in the National Assembly of Quebec.
You can compare each party's promises around key issues using CBC's platform tracker.
CBC News will be live on election night online, as well as on TV and radio as of 7:30 p.m. ET. Polling stations close across the province at 8 p.m. ET.
